name: Justice
subtitle: A fair and impartial Judge, of contest and character
body:
You are a justice! You have trained for years in Law, the Code Duello, and Honorable Conduct.

Starting Resources: 4 coins

name: Healer
subtitle: Hailing from the tower of Caduceus, you bring mercy to the injured
body:
You have been trained in the ways of a healer and medic. You can bring people back from near death.

Starting Resources: 1 coin

**Power: Heal**
Spend 30 seconds roleplaying healing someone who has been injured then show them this power.

They are healed and can move normally.

(Normally, someone who has been injured must roleplay being injured, and cant move faster than a walk nor fight)

(You may heal yourself, but not while you are near combat)

name: Scion
subtitle: You're rich.
body:
You're rich, and you want everyone to know it.

Starting Equipment: 12 coins

**Power: Have a Tip**
When someone does something you told them to:
Pay them 1 extra coin (On top of what you agreed to)

No person can be the target of this power more than once per hour.

**Power: My Loyal Second**
If someone agrees to be your second, show them this power.

Any time someone challenges you to a duel or contest, you may have your second take your place. If you do, you receive all rewards and consequences of your contest still, but it is your second who participates.
(You may only have one second at a time)

name: Scoundrel
subtitle: You don't mind being a villain
body:
Starting Equipment: 0 coins

**Item: Spinefish Venom**
You coat your blades in venom. Show this to a player before you fight them.

"My blades are coated in venom! After I strike you roleplay feeling weak and woozy for 15 minutes or until a healer attends to you. You don't know you've been poisoned, only that you don't feel very good"

Limited supply: You can only use this power once
Buy some more: You can use it one more time each time you put one of your coins back in the money vessel.
Sell it: You can tear this power off your sheet to sell it.

name: Smuggler
subtitle: You don't mind being a villain
body:
**Power: Pickpocket**
You pickpocket someone. Show this to another player and guess one of their pockets. If they have any silver in that pocket, they must give you one of them.

Can never be used on the same player twice

**Item: The Goods**
You have the goods. You got them from your supplier. Someone in this town wants them and you'll make a pretty penny if you can figure out who.

But you know someone else is on to your scent. If they find out you got The Goods they'll bring the law down on you.

You can tear this off your character sheet to give it to someone.

name: Merchant
subtitle: An entrepreneur
body:
Starting Equipment: Merchant starter pack

**Supplier:** Throughout the day your supplier from Grand Harbor will come with shipments. You must have cash on hand to pay them for additional goods when they arrive.

**Competition:** Another merchant is here. Your store, which you must name, is clearly better than theirs.

name: Merchant
subtitle: An entrepreneur
body:
Starting Equipment: Merchant starter pack

**Supplier:** Throughout the day your supplier from Grand Harbor will come with shipments. You must have cash on hand to pay them for additional goods when they arrive.

**Competition:** Another merchant is here. Your store, which you must name, is clearly better than theirs.

name: Constable
subtitle: You want to enforce the laws
body:
You're good at arresting people (but not actually arresting them)

Starting Equipment: 2 coins

**Power: Make Jail**
Use your foot and draw a circle in the dirt. That's the jail.
You can have multiple jail cells, but they must be nearby each other. If you move the jail be sure to scratch out the old circle.

**Power: Arrest**
If you see someone commit a crime you can arrest them by doing the following:
Announce they are under arrest
Announce their crime they committed.
Show them this power
Bring them to the jail
They must stand in jail for 5 minutes

Here are all the things that are crimes:
Attacking someone (outside of a duel)
Wanting or having The Goods (specific item)
Conspiring against nobility
Cheating in a Duel
Hiding information related to The Prophecy
Insulting someone's Art

(Try your best not to use this power in ways that are unfun)

**Power: Deputize**
You can have one deputy. Show them the arrest power. For as long as they are your deputy they may use the arrest power. Both you and your deputy can let people out of jail for any reason.

name: Herbalist
subtitle: You want to make potions
body:
You enjoy whimsical, slightly nonsensical abilities

Starting Equipment: 2 coins

**Power: Brew Potion**
To use this power you must get an assistant. Show them this power and then roleplay brewing a potion for 10 seconds.

When the potion is finished flip a coin.
On a heads the potion is a success. A one use item that you possess can be used again as if it hadn't been used.
On a tails the potion explodes and you and your partner become injured. (roleplay being injured, move no faster than a walk, can't do combat)
Each time you use this power you can't use it again for an hour.

You may tear items off your sheet and give them to people.
Potions can be used on another character if the players agree to it.

**Item: Potion of Polymorph - One use only**
You turn into an animal! The choice of animal is up to you. You must act like the animal for 5 minutes. If anyone doubts your animalness show them this card

**Item: Potion of Sneeze - One use only**
You must immediately sneeze very loudly.

**Item: Clue Fragment**
Turn 3 of these into the npc station for a clue to the prophecy

name: Scholar
subtitle: You like having your head in a dusty old book
body:
Starting Equipment: 2 coins

You can tear these items off your sheet in order to trade them to other players.

**Power: Brew Potion**
To use this power you must get an assistant. Show them this power and then roleplay brewing a potion for 10 seconds.

When the potion is finished flip a coin.
On a heads the potion is a success. A one use item that you possess can be used again as if it hadn't been used.
On a tails the potion explodes and you and your partner become injured. (roleplay being injured, move no faster than a walk, can't do combat)
Each time you use this power you can't use it again for an hour.

**Item: Clue Fragment**
Turn 3 of these into the npc station for a clue to the prophecy

name: Peasant
subtitle: You want to work for pay
body:
Starting Equipment: 1 coin

**Power: Peasant Work**
Spend a full 10 minutes miming/pretending to do some form of labor. When you are done you may take 2 silver from the cup.

You can use this power at most once each hour.
(farming, begging, busking, smithing are all valid. You can choose the kind of work as long as someone could feasibly make money doing it and it is obvious you are hard at work for the full 10 minutes)

**Power: Peasant Revolution!**
If you think the mayor is doing a bad job, you may lead a peasant revolution. Spend at least 30 minutes rallying people and telling them why you need a new mayor, then confront the mayor and show them this power.
The mayor then has 10 minutes to rally a coalition larger than yours. If they cannot, you or a consenting player of your choice becomes the mayor.

name: Bard
subtitle: You want to write songs
body:
Starting Equipment: 2 coins

**Power: Sing a Grand Song**
Invent a song about a person or deed or situation you witnessed. Perform it for the person.

**Item: Ring of Terrible Luck**
This ring is bad news. You do not want it. You can only give it to someone else if they say the words "I accept this ring"
When someone takes the ring, give them both the ring and this card.
(Tear it from your character sheet if you need to)

name: Notary
subtitle: You want to have a stamp more than anything
body:
Starting Equipment: 2 coins

**Item: Stamp**
When you stamp a document, it becomes 'official.' Harder to contest in a court of law and all around fancier looking.

**Item: Signed Paper**
The paper you start with has a perfect forged signature of the Lord Veyron Malchore, Head of the Guild of Fancy Goods

name: Highwayman
subtitle: You want to play as a villain
body:
You want to do combat with other players
You are comfortable being arrested

**Secret:** You and the mayor are working together. It would be bad for both of you if this got out.
When you pick up this character, immediately introduce yourself to the mayor.
You may only use your Rob power on someone the mayor has hired you to rob.
The mayor will pay you for each robbery.

**Power: Rob**
When you want to rob someone tell them you are robbing them and show them this power.

You are being robbed! But I am a polite robber. If you really don't want to be robbed, you may say "I would like to decline this robbing" and I will leave you alone

If we're around a crowd, you may call for help. People who respond may help chase me away. If we're away from the main space, you may not call for help.

Otherwise, you must duel me. The loser becomes Wounded.

**Power: Secret Identity**
If someone accuses you of robbing people, you may show them this power.
You've mistaken me for someone else! It's obvious now that you've had a second look at me that I can't possibly be a robber. You must act suitably confused and say "Huh? Where'd they go?" or "Sorry I got the wrong guy" or something similar.
You may not use this power on someone who defeated you while you were trying to rob them.

name: Town Crier
subtitle: You like being loud
body:
You don't mind being told what to do

Starting Equipment: 2 coins

**Power: Cry**
In order to Cry, you must loudly announce something. You must continue to announce it until you are reasonably certain everyone has heard it.

**Power: Just Part of the Job**
When someone asks you to Cry something and you do it, you may take one silver from the vessel.

Each time you use this power, you can't use it again for the next hour.

name: Astrologer
subtitle: Looks to the stars and portends the future
body:
Starting Equipment: 1 coin, tarot deck

**Celestial Event:** You've come to Chicken's Rest because you know there will be a truly incredible celestial event visible from here today.

**The Reading of the Skies:** Your charts whisper a cryptic hint — the great event will come a little before dusk. When the light begins to fail and the sun dips low, keep your eyes on the heavens.

**Power: Portents**
Tell a fortune for a character. If they later tell you it came true for them, you may take 1 coin from the box.

A character can't have their future told more than once per hour.

name: Postperson
subtitle: Neither rain, nor sleet, nor dark of night
body:
Starting Equipment: 2 coins, pile of post

**You've got mail!**
Sometimes you will receive mail. The mail in your pile o' post will materialize at the given time. It cannot be opened before then. It is all addressed to a given person, but it is up to you if you deliver it to them.

**Power: Deliver Mail**
You may deliver mail to the Storytellers. Each time you do so you must give them 2 coins as postage along with the post. The mail MUST have an address on it, and may optionally have a name. Both can be made up.

name: Illiterate
subtitle: You start with a book
body:
Starting Equipment: 1 coin, The Cursed Tome

**The Book:** One day recently your Family Book started behaving oddly. Glowing purple at night, flapping to random pages.

**Cursed:** Take one of the curses from the book to begin the game.

**Illiterate:** You cannot read.

name: Pirate
subtitle: You want to get drunk
body:
Starting Equipment: 2 dogwheat

**Proprietor:** You are the owner of the Pirate Bar in Chicken's Rest.

**Power: Brew Ale**
At any time, you can exchange 1 dogwheat or 1 ghost pepper for 1 Pirate's Brew from slot 12 at the potion station.

(Pirate's Brew: Makes you forget your troubles. You become intoxicated for ~10 minutes. You also forget to be bothered by one thing that was bothering you.)
